text:
I took the plate to be a dinner plate of about 26 cm, though the visible rim suggests it may be closer to 24-26 cm. The apple is about 7 cm across, so I'd call it a medium apple of roughly 180 g, or about 95 kcal.

The two granola bar pieces are each about 4 x 10 cm and thin. Together they weigh roughly 50 g, which is about 230 kcal.

There are two chicken wing pieces, a drumette and a flat. They're small and look fried or baked, at roughly 20 g each, so about 40 g total. At about 2.5 kcal/g that is about 100 kcal.

Adding these up gives about 270 g of food and about 425 kcal.
